**Evidence for triage (spec@objectui seat, session `session_01V3hPr7riucnMfhcHY86Msd`, 2026-09-02; no grading, no label change).** Measured on objectui `origin/main` `67dadd6` and objectstack `origin/main`.

- **Premise still true.** `packages/types/src/objectql.ts:1132` `className?: string` and `:1138` `gridClassName?: string` on `ObjectFormSection`, doc comments still describe an effect nothing delivers. Read sites of those two members via `ObjectFormSection`: **zero** — `ObjectForm.tsx` keeps only deliberate-omission comments naming #13626 (lines 293/317/350/384/450); control: `s.columns` / `section.columns` reads still hit (5+2+3+2 across ObjectForm/ModalForm/SplitForm/TabbedForm), so the zero is real.
- **Sibling per-layout config types are NOT the same case**: `ModalFormSectionConfig` (`ModalForm.tsx:89/95`), `SplitFormSectionConfig` (`SplitForm.tsx:57/64`), TabbedForm `FormSectionConfig` (`:92/98`), `WizardStepConfig` (`:141/146`), `DrawerFormSectionConfig` (`:90`) are read uncast (`ModalForm.tsx:667-668/697`, `SplitForm.tsx:393/414`, `TabbedForm.tsx:469`, `WizardForm.tsx:1024-1025`) — live for programmatic mounts (`AppContent.tsx:1044`, `useActionModal.tsx:253`, `plugin-designer/ObjectManager.tsx:262`); `ObjectForm` rebuilds `sections` key-by-key and drops both keys (`ObjectForm.tsx:395-445`). A fix scoped to `ObjectFormSection` must leave those five alone.
- **Upstream ruling to inherit** (objectstack#13626, maintainer 2026-09-01, director batch C 「同意」, verbatim): "retire the reads … Declaring the keys was weighed and not adopted: it would formally invite free Tailwind strings into authored metadata, the exact class the boundary exists to keep out." Spec side: `FormSectionSchema` (`view.zod.ts:2485`) is a `strictObject` with neither key; `gridClassName` has zero hits in `packages/spec/src`. Nothing in a spec release is involved — this is objectui-internal, not release-gated.
- **Blast radius of retiring the two declarations**: `@object-ui/types` published surface (changeset `minor` per the fixed-group rule, never `major`); `packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/sectionStyleKeysRetired-13626.test.tsx:91-92,99-100` authors both keys on an `ObjectFormSection`-typed fixture and would fail type-check — must be rewritten to a cast/literal in the same PR; docs: zero `gridClassName` under `content/docs`, `plugin-form/README.md:379-407` already teaches "section styling is not authorable".
- Not measured: downstream consumers outside this repo constructing `ObjectFormSection` literals with these keys.

Reading: same-family as #13626 (mother ruling: do not declare), fix = delete two members + fixture update, S-size, `packages/types` only. Grading is triage's.
